content: विनिपत् €1 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To fly at, fall down, descend; विनिपतिततुषारः क्रौञ्चनादोपगीतः <ls>Ṛs. 4. 18</ls> (<ab>v. l.</ab>). .²2 To attack, assail. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To cause to fall down, ruin, destroy; कटेन विनिपातितो यामि <ls>Mk. 2. 8</ls>. .²2 To throw or pull down. .²3 To kill, deprive of life.
